failure_summary.description: The agent echoed a foreign word already in the clue ('Ananas' from 'Coupes A L'Ananas') instead of the English referent. The gold key is also plural ('Pineapples'), matching the clue's plural 'not bananas'.
The agent kept a passage modifier ('sea lamprey') that contradicts the clue's own descriptor ('freshwater'). The gold key is the bare standard name.

The passages list several holders of the same office. The agent picked the one whose passage best matched the office wording (the 'served as mayor' description), not the one tied to the headline event, and wrote a quoted-nickname name form.

patch.reasoning: Steps 31-35 tried a mandatory check line at the top and were rejected, so these edits avoid that and give narrow, clue-visible rules in Rule 2. Edit 1 covers foreign words inside the clue: translate them, and match the plural of the clue's contrasting item. Edit 2 covers a passage modifier that conflicts with a clue descriptor: drop it and use the bare standard name. Edit 3 covers person clues where several office-holders appear: use the event or notoriety detail as the tie-breaker, and give a plain First Last form.

edits.target: ## Rule 2: Answer the referent, not a word from the clue
edits.content: - FOREIGN WORD INSIDE THE CLUE ('Coupes A L'Ananas are desserts made with this tropical fruit', 'Gazpacho', 'Pain au chocolat'): the foreign term is an anchor. If the clue asks for 'this <thing>' and your candidate is that foreign word or a form of it ('Ananas'), translate it to the English name the clue is hinting at ('Pineapple'). Number: when the clue contrasts the answer with a plural item ('not bananas') or the answer is a fruit, vegetable or crop used as an ingredient, give the plural ('Pineapples').

edits.target: ## Rule 2: Answer the referent, not a word from the clue
edits.content: - DESCRIPTOR CONFLICT: if a passage modifier on your candidate contradicts a descriptor in the clue ('freshwater' clue vs 'sea lamprey', 'Atlantic' vs 'Pacific', 'wild' vs 'domestic'), the modifier is wrong for this clue. Drop it and answer with the bare standard name shared by the passages' headword ('lamprey'). More generally, when the clue says only 'this <fish/bird/tree/animal>', give the common name, not a specific species or variety name picked up from one passage.

edits.target: ## Rule 2: Answer the referent, not a word from the clue
edits.content: - PERSON CLUES WITH 'HIS/HER' + an office or role and an EVENT ('His 2-week sabbatical as mayor of Washington, D.C. made headlines'): passages often list several holders of the same office. The title words only narrow the field. Pick the holder tied to the clue's specific event, scandal or era, using your own knowledge of who was famous for it. Do not take the first or best-described office-holder. Check that the person's dates fit the event. Write the person as 'First Last', with no quoted nickname, no middle name and no parenthetical.
